_comment: Risk modifiers. If ANY applies, the urgency is raised by ONE level (never stacked), up to max_level. They never push a case to 'emergency'; only red flags do that.

reasons.young_age: Young children can become unwell faster, so the level was raised.
reasons.old_age: Age 65 or over carries higher risk, so the level was raised.
reasons.chronic: A long-term condition raises risk, so the level was raised.
reasons.pregnancy: Possible pregnancy needs a more cautious approach, so the level was raised.
